rules.scope: 24 existing species and 10 existing raid encounters; no new spawns or runtime edits
rules.ecology_status: lore and encounter-design proposal; predator/prey simulation not implemented
rules.level_health_xp_gold: preserve actual appearances/raids values; base monster level=0 is not an encounter level
rules.damage: pattern multiplier times current encounter attack before existing defenses; a hit affects each target once
rules.resistance: proposal only: damage multiplied by 1-resistance; unspecified=0; not an additional defense layer yet
rules.normal_cc: slow25%2s; no repeated hard stun; no mana drain substitution for stamina
rules.attack_tracking: lock target position at telegraph start; no homing during windup
rules.scheduling: one attack per enemy; cooldown starts after recovery; same pack max2 simultaneous damaging windups
rules.coop: retain host authority, private rewards and current party_rules scaling; no player-count damage increase

boss_stagger.wall_collision: may call existing guarded break_boss; never bypass immune/down

rules.drops: retain all current independent rolls and raid extra-equipment rolls; trophies are separately proposed
rules.trophy: one bound research/cosmetic material per eligible personal kill roll; no sale or power recipe in v1
rules.new_statuses: poison/bleed/debuff interactions need implementation; pattern names alone do not apply a status
